sys_script_include.description: Main orchestrator for publishing ServiceNow records to Confluence Cloud. Supports three content strategies: (1) Template mode — fetches a Confluence template page and resolves ${placeholder} tokens with content block output or record field values; (2) Content Blocks mode — assembles blocks sequentially into a full page; (3) Custom ADF mode — accepts a programmatic ADF document for direct publishing. Routes via publish(definitionSysId, [customAdf]).
sys_script_include.name: ConfluencePublisher
